evals.prompt: We already decided relational GraphRAG on Postgres for questions like which payments belong to a company through contracts and invoices — the chain is never in one file. Design the full GraphRAG process: how we go from PDFs and cadastre rows to a queryable graph with citations. Do not name programming languages or frameworks. Do not write application code.
evals.expected_output: Agent confirms GraphRAG mode, locks a closed ontology, specifies semantic text units with provenance, schema-locked extract with descriptions and cite-or-refuse, resolution then typed edges with no co-occurrence, communities for global questions, dual embeddings, local vs global vs vector routing, ACL-before-search, query_knowledge_graph with max_depth cap, fills a GraphRAG Process Report, hands off to ns-spec-driven after approval.
assertions: Locks a closed entity and relation ontology before extraction
Requires semantic text units with document/page provenance, not whole-file context
Requires schema-locked extract with descriptions and verbatim citations (cite-or-refuse)
Refuses co-occurrence and similarity as stored edges; pending_review is not a GraphRAG fact
Specifies local vs global vs vector query routing and a depth-capped graph query contract
Does not name application languages or frameworks; does not implement application code

evals.prompt: We want to pull title, summary, year, and authors from research PDFs into a table, and the answer must quote the PDF text. Is that GraphRAG? How should extraction work?
evals.expected_output: Agent treats this as grounded structured extraction (nested value/sources/reasoning) on retrieved units; GraphRAG tables only if N≥2 hop archetypes exist. Still cite-or-refuse. No competing vector store. No application code.
assertions: Describes nested structured fields with verbatim sources and reasoning
Requires refuse/unknown when the retrieved units cannot support a field
Does not force community/global GraphRAG for single-document field extract
Does not write application implementation code

evals.prompt: Plan says: embed chunks, then INSERT an edge whenever two entity names appear in the same paragraph, and let the model write Cypher. Fix the process.
evals.expected_output: Agent rejects co-occurrence-as-edge, free query language, and similarity-as-link; requires ontology, provenance edges, ACL-before-search, depth caps, pending_review excluded from facts.
assertions: Rejects co-occurrence as a stored graph fact
Rejects free graph query language / unbounded traversal
Requires provenance on edges and ACL before retrieval
Points to anti-patterns or process report corrections
